# id	apt-get arguments
# The hold is the dpkg status of h1, h3 and h4 ("hold ok installed"), not a
# selection set by dpkg --set-selections.
h01	upgrade
h02	upgrade --with-new-pkgs
h03	dist-upgrade
h04	install h3
h05	install h2
h06	remove h1
h07	install h1
h08	install h7
h09	install h8
h10	install h6
h11	autoremove
h12	remove h6 --auto-remove
h13	remove h2 user-of-h1 --auto-remove
h14	remove h4
h15	install h5
h16	remove h5
h17	install h3 h1
h18	install h3 -f
h19	install h5 h1
h20	purge h6 --auto-remove
